entries.name: Resonance
entries.description: Struck from the seams beneath the academy. Resonance holds a shape until something breaks it, which is why its students are the ones who finish long duels.

entries.name: Verdance
entries.description: Grown rather than made. Verdance rarely wins a turn and rarely loses a match, and the terraces are full of students who learned that the hard way.

entries.name: Ember
entries.description: Cut from wood that never cooled. Ember spends what it has early and asks the duel to end before the accounting.

entries.name: Cipher
entries.description: The only school with no seam and no grove. Cipher is written rather than gathered, and its students are the ones who decide what a duel is about.
